sentences.text: The depth sounder sends a sound pulse down and times its echo.
It shows depth below the transducer, unless you’ve set an offset to show depth below the keel or below the waterline, so know how yours is set.
Depth is a powerful navigation check.
Compare your reading with the charted depth plus the height of tide to confirm your position, and in poor visibility you can follow a depth contour toward a harbor.
Set a shallow-water alarm as a safety net, especially in Florida’s skinny water.
